newsitem.title: UK: IADB plans $1.0 bln 10-year global bond -dealers.
newsitem.headline: IADB plans $1.0 bln 10-year global bond -dealers.

text.p: The Inter-American Development Bank (IADB) is expected to launch a jumbo dollar global bond this week, syndicate officials said on Monday.
The transaction is expected to be for $1.0 billion at a 10-year maturity.
Market traders said a spread of 16-18 basis points over U.S. Treasuries was likely for the triple-A rated borrower.
No mandate for the transaction has yet been awarded, although a number of investment banks are in the running.

The IADB launched a $1.0 billion 10-year global bond in early March last year via joint lead managers Merrill Lynch and SBC Warburg to yield 29 b.p. over the 5.625 percent U.S. Treasury note due February 2006.
The paper paid a coupon of 6.125 percent.
The global issue was trading at a spread of 15/13 b.p. over the current 10-year U.S. Treasury at 1250 GMT, dealers said.
